notes.content:
[h1]UPDATE[/h1]
Hello Dishwashers, sorry for the wait! As mentioned previously, I've been busy with full time work and have been getting into the rhythm. While there's no content in this patch, it should address some of the more egregious issues.

If you find any major issues/oversights, join the discord and ping me (link is on the main menu) and send me your save file. (win + r > appdata > enter > /local > /DWS)

[b]Old saves may have a few issues with the fixes relating to farming plots, just replace them![/b]

[h1]FIXES[/h1]

[list]
[*] fixed double wakeup bug
[*] fixed bug the caused crops to not disappear  when deconstructing plot (existing plots may have some issues, just replace them)
[*] applied a few potential fixes to a bug where items would not get saved (tentative, please let me know)
[*] more changes/fixes to physics stability (this is an ongoing battle lol)
[/list]
[h1]CHANGES[/h1]

[list]
[*] adjustments to crates collision to help with the mythic flipping crate issue
[/list][h1]ADDED[/h1]

[list]
[*] added option for mouse smoothing
[*] added option for inverting mouse (x and y)
[*] added conveyers belt side blockers
[/list]

notes.content:
[h3]Sorry for the delay, some of these fixes are just time consuming!
[/h3]

[h1]CONTENT:
[/h1]- added a glass dish - careful handling it... it may break
- added a toilet to the store
- added poop

[h1]CHANGES:
[/h1]- fixed rotation axis, items will now rotate based consistently with the cameras forward axis
- added the ability to move/shift your grabbed object without moving your head, this will help with those who get motion sickness while washing dishes! (Left Alt by default)
- adjusted audio mastering
- added building key bindings
- added movement key bindings

[h1]FIXES[/h1]
- dishes should no longer clip inside the sink
- fixed various issues in manor
- fixed boxes attaching to each other causing them to disappear
- physics items will now awaken when nearby buildings are repackaged (no more floating sponge)
- the unlock computer phone call will no longer reoccur
- potential fix for depths not generating
- screen should no longer be typed on when not in use
- potential fix for black screen load bug

Here's an example of how to use the new grab offset:
[previewyoutube=AI5T0wVLuQA;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: 1000 Units Sold ! Thanks for the Support
notes.content:
It’s been awesome seeing so many of you enjoy the game, we hit a peak player count of 86 players a few minutes ago

[h3]If you had a good time, leave a review! Even a short one! It really helps us out![/h3]

[h3] What's Next? [/h3]
Primary focus is on stability updates/Qol, the list includes:

[list]
[*] movement keybindings
[*] stop the elevator from eating things
[*] general collision and visual fixes
[*] computer screen fov fixes for widescreen's
[*] translation to chinese and russian
[*] audio mastering fixes
[*] rotation axis fix for items
[*] achievements
[/list]
Keep reporting bugs! I'll make note. Once again, thanks for playing, and keep washing those dishes.
